More ways to add an item

Five ways to add items to a roadmap beyond today's one “Add an item” button. Every design keeps that button and today's item dialog; each adds one way in. Sample world: Sam Rees, Product Lead of Appointments roadmap (published, Updated 4 November 2026), on 20 November 2026, with no unpublished changes until each design adds.

1. Add items to a roadmap

Sam is on Appointments roadmap with new work to add. A and B start one item from where it will go or from an item like it; C and D add several at once; E is quick add: a title typed at the end of a horizon or section; it has a working version too.
